cards.headline: Katharina Kisser + Physio Kraft: 30-min malware watch has stayed clean for ~12h since cleanup — step down or keep tight?
cards.why: Reinfection risk is highest in the first 48h after a cleanup; one more day of tight watch is cheap insurance.

options.b: Keep 30-min watch another 24h to be safe
options.c: Stop the extra watch, rely on normal site monitoring
